nanath_10.m: You? How dare you show your face?

nanath_12.m: You? How dare you show your face?

nanath_18.m: You betrayed the Guild over the task with Defy. Get out!

umar_2.m: Last time we talked, you asked for the way to Lodar's Hideaway. Did you find it?
r: You must have me confused with my brother Andor. We look very much alike.

umar_3.m: Oh. I must have you confused with someone else.
r: My brother Andor and I look very much alike.

umar_4.m: Really? Never mind I said anything then.
r: I guess that means that Andor was here. What was he doing?

umar_5.m: He came here a while ago, asking a lot of questions about what relation the Thieves' Guild has to the Shadow and to the royal guard in Feygard.

umar_6.m: We in the Thieves' Guild really don't care much for the Shadow. Nor do we care for the royal guard.

umar_7.m: We try to be above their bickering and differences. They may fight as much as they want, but the Thieves' Guild will outlive them all.
r: Tell me more about what Andor asked for.

umar_andor_1.m: He asked me for my support, and asked about how to find Lodar.

umar_andor_2.m: Lodar? He is one of the famous potion makers from the old days. The Thieves' Guild has requested his services many times before. He can make all sorts of strong sleeping potions, healing potions and cures.

umar_andor_3.m: But his specialty is, of course, his poisons. His poison can harm even the largest of monsters.
r: What would Andor want with him?

umar_andor_4.m: I don't know. Maybe he was looking for a potion.
r: So, where can I find this Lodar?

umar_conflict_1.m: Where have you been the last couple of years? Don't you know of the brewing conflict?

umar_conflict_2.m: The royal guard, led by Lord Geomyr in Feygard, are trying to ward off the recent increase in illegal activities, and are therefore imposing more restrictions on what is or is not allowed.

umar_conflict_3.m: The priests of the Shadow, mostly seated in Nor City, are opposed to the new restrictions, saying that they limit the ways that they can please the Shadow.

umar_conflict_4.m: In turn, the rumor is that the priests of the Shadow are planning to overthrow Lord Geomyr and his forces.

umar_conflict_5.m: Also, the rumor is that the priests of the Shadow are still doing their rituals, despite the fact that most of the rituals have been banned.

umar_conflict_6.m: Lord Geomyr and his royal guard on the other hand, are still trying their best to rule in a way that they feel is fair.

umar_conflict_7.m: We in the Thieves' Guild try not to get involved in the conflict. Our business is so far unaffected by all of this.

umar_guild02_1.m: Excellent, young friend. Consider yourself a member of our Guild.
r: Meh, that was nothing special. Bye.
OK, nice to see you again.
Hah, what an honor! It has been so, so difficult ....

umar_guild02_10.m: I want you to bring the noble woman here, so that we can ask for a substantial ransom from her generous father.
r: Where can I find this woman?

umar_guild02_11a.m: Great ... Before you go, I should tell you where she is.

umar_guild02_11b.m: Scouts have seen the lady in the Foaming flask tavern. We do not want to be discovered, so act quietly. Guards are a problem though. It's up to you how you choose to solve the guards problem.
r: Seems difficult, but whatever. I'll do it.

umar_guild02_12.m: Good luck. Return to me when you're done.
r: Wait, wait! How am I supposed to ...
I will bring her, even if I have to eliminate Feygard's entire army!

umar_guild02_13.m: Use your tongue, young man. Sometimes it is more important than your sword skills.
r: Hah! I don't think so. But anyway, thank you for the advice.
I'll do that, thanks for the advice.

umar_guild02_14.m: Remember that if you are discovered, you are no one. No one knows you. And of course, no one has seen you. You are now a member of the guild, so don't fail.
r: You still think I'm a novice, right? You're going to see that you're wrong!

umar_guild02_15.m: No, I've told you all you need to know. Now leave me please, I've work to do.

umar_guild02_16.m:
(You put Ambelie, who is still unconscious, in a chair next to you)

Oh! How did you get here so fast? I've heard reports of a barricade blocking the way from the Duleian road to Fallhaven.
r: Barricades, guards ... no big thing for me.

umar_guild02_17.m: OK, well done. Now we will have to find a better place for our guest. Keeping this lady here could be dangerous for us.
r: I'm sure that's the case, but that's not my problem anymore. Right?
Well, I have no choice. What should I do?

umar_guild02_18b.m: Hmm, let me think about it ....

umar_guild02_19.m: We are supposed to have one room for receiving "visitors". However, I don't know if It's finished.

umar_guild02_2.m: I detect a certain sarcasm in your words.
r: No, no .... Never mind, see you later.
That's maybe because I am trying to be sarcastic ...

umar_guild02_20.m: Hmm, I believe Troublemaker knows the actual state of that place. Ask him, and if it's possible leave our guest there.
r: OK, I will. (You lift Ambelie up and carry her on your shoulders)
Hmpf ... Bye (You lift Ambelie up and carry her on your shoulders)

umar_guild02_21.m: Simple. Talk with Troublemaker about this job. He probably knows of some safe place to keep her. Then return to me.

umar_guild02_22.m: Fine .... Although you look odd. What's the matter?
r: It's OK ... it's just that is not my kind of work.
Urgh ... I just need better tasks! Do you still think I'm not yet ready?

umar_guild02_23a.m: Sometimes people must do things that they don't like. Maybe you're still too young to understand that?

umar_guild02_23b.m: No, nothing of the kind! I was .... Well, let's talk.

umar_guild02_24a.m: Well .... Anyway, I promise we won't give you those kind of jobs for a while.
r: That is good news for me.

umar_guild02_25.m: First of all, take this gold for a job well done. We have already sent people to ask for the ransom.

umar_guild02_26.m:
(Umar looks a little worried)

This is really not your line of work huh?
I suggest you rest for a while before doing more. You look tired.
r: Tired? I don't know what that means!

umar_guild02_27a.m: I prefer that you are completely rested before talking about work.

umar_guild02_27b.m: Don't be overconfident. Take my advice and rest. We'll talk tomorrow.

umar_guild02_27c.m:
Come back to me when you're prepared. Bear in mind that your next task isn't going to be as easy as the ones you already did.
We'll talk about that tomorrow.
r: I expected that. See you tomorrow then.
Easy? Argh, they've been so difficult! Good night.

umar_guild02_27d.m: I'm afraid all the beds at the guild are taken for the night. We have arrangements at the inn in town though. If you tell them Umar sent you then you will not have to pay for a bed.

umar_guild02_28.m: I see guilt in your eyes, my young friend.
r: I couldn't accomplish the objective, I'm sorry.
I felt sorry for that woman, and I decided to extort her and get the gold directly.

umar_guild02_29a.m: You don't need to tell me things I can see with my own eyes, it is a waste of time.

umar_guild02_29b.m: Being a good liar is a very valuable ability for the guild, but useless against me.

r: Just give me a high-risk job, please.
I mean my last job was a piece of cake. I need something more exciting!

umar_guild02_30.m: I expect more of you. That was your first mission inside the guild and you failed it!
r: I brought a valuable necklace from the noblewoman.

umar_guild02_31.m: What we have here? (Umar's face gets a smile while he admires the necklace)

umar_guild02_32.m: Well. I will take it as compensation for your mistakes.

umar_guild02_4.m: If you want me to give you a more difficult task, then I am happy to do so.
r: OK, in that case tell me what it is.

umar_guild02_5a.m: But first I have to clarify something. You need to be more careful not to give information to outsiders about the Thieves' Guild.
r: You're right. It will not happen again.

umar_guild02_5b.m: Yes, you mentioned Fanamor's membership to Thoronir.

umar_guild02_5c.m: Fortunately, Thoronir will keep quiet, as he certainly does not want to give up our donations.
r: You're right. It will not happen again.

umar_guild02_5d.m: You still have many things to learn, young apprentice.

umar_guild02_5z.m: Well, before I can give you a very demanding job, I need you to do another ... retrieval task.
r: Anything for the glory o... Oops, I mean OK

umar_guild02_6a.m: Excellent. I warn you that this is not an ordinary retrieval. It's more like a ... kidnapping.
r: Can you get to the point please?
Sounds too shady for me. I think I prefer to not do that task for now.

umar_guild02_6b.m: Just tell me when you want to do the job. Bye

umar_guild02_8.m:
Nothing unusual about that. But in this case we've discovered that the woman is the daughter of Hertzsen Laumwill, patriarch of the Laumwill family.

(You look around, trying to remember someone, but nothing comes to you)

umar_guild02_9.m: To help you understand, they are one of the richest Feygard families, very close to Lord Geomyr.
r: OK, so what I have to do?
I ... understand. So what's my task?

umar_guild03_1.m: I see you are better than yesterday.

umar_guild03_10a.m: Let's just say that's not important to you at this moment. What they did is more important now.

umar_guild03_10b.m: The team leader and others loyal to him killed the rest of the team and escaped with the key, before entering the church. They have probably deciphered the code and they want to sell the information to the highest bidder. That happened three nights ago.

umar_guild03_11a.m: Honestly, I don't know for certain.

umar_guild03_11b.m: Apparently they decided the Guild wasn't the best option, so they turned greedy and betrayed us. That's more common than I would like to admit.
r: They have signed their own death sentence.

umar_guild03_12.m: There's more. Two days ago the southern route from here to the Duleian road was closed, because there was a murder. Soldiers are trying to prevent the murderer from escaping to the west.
r: And you think the traitors are involved in that?

umar_guild03_13.m: I'm pretty sure about it. The team leader is the one we call "Crackshot", as he is a master of murder, torture and the subjugation arts. He's really a dangerous man.
r: So, do you have a plan?
What am I supposed to do?

umar_guild03_14.m: Hmm ... I think we have no choice. We'll have to deal with him and his henchmen ... forever.
r: OK, leave this to me. That's finally the kind of work I was searching for.
I ... I prefer to not get involved into this. Sorry.

umar_guild03_15a.m: Are you completely sure? You will be alone against trained thieves and other criminals whose sole objective is to earn more and more gold.
r: I can deal with them with my bare hands!

umar_guild03_15b.m: Maybe it's not the best time. We must bring him down. Think about it. There are probably many lives at risk ...

umar_guild03_16.m: Whatever, I do believe you are capable. Regardless, be cautious with Crackshot. He's powerful, and his attacks can severely wound or kill you. Clear?
r: Bah, words are worth nothing now. It's going to be a nice fight.

umar_guild03_17a.m: If you say so. Your self-confidence is a good aspect of your personality.

umar_guild03_17b.m: However, there's still a problem. We're not completely sure about the location of Crackshot's new hideout.
r: What? How I will find him then?
He will show up sooner or later ...

umar_guild03_18a.m: Probably people near the Duleian road guard tower know more. See if you can ask them for tips.

umar_guild03_18b.m: Maybe, but it will be faster if you question people near the Duleian road guard tower. The Duleian road is the place where we think he was last seen.
r: Argh, the Duleian road is big!

umar_guild03_19a.m: Sorry, I have no more information. If you need anything come back. Good luck.

umar_guild03_19b.m: That's why you have to ask.

umar_guild03_19c.m: Make sure you don't talk about the Guild and his relationship with us. Don't trust anyone.
r: I won't even trust my shadow.
Sure, tell me what you have to say.

umar_guild03_20.m: Remember, this is an important mission! Don't forget it again!

umar_guild03_21.m: First, you must find Crackshot's hideout.

umar_guild03_22.m: Then you will have to deal with him and his henchmen, and finally bring back the Key of Luthor to us.

r: Can you explain it to me again?

umar_guild03_24b.m:
Are you serious?
Bah, I'll repeat it for you ...

umar_guild03_25.m: Excellent. Did he have the key with him?
r: Yes ... [give key]. Why is this key so important to us?
Sure, here, take it. And maybe it's time to give me some more information.
He had the key, but I don't have it with me.

umar_guild03_25_1.m: Don't try to fool me. I am Umar. I know you have it.
r: Oh. Yes, I remember now that I found the key. Here, take it.
Even if I have the key, I won't give it to you.

umar_guild03_25_1a.m: Come back when you are sane again.

umar_guild03_25_2.m: Then what you are waiting for? Go and get it!

umar_guild03_25_3.m: Why did it take so long? And do not look at me that way. I can not tell you anything about the key for now.

umar_guild03_26a.m: I'm sorry, but for now I can't say more.

umar_guild03_26b.m: Be patient, my friend. Everything will come in due time.
r: I expect my patience will be rewarded.

umar_guild03_27a_1.m: Anyway, you've done your work. My spies reported to me that you saved someone's life.
r: If your spies help me, tasks would be easier.
Yeah. He was a Feygard officer ... a sergeant I think.

umar_guild03_27a_2.m: Anyway, you've done your work. My spies reported to me you had saved someone's life.
r: If your spies help me, tasks would be easier.
I tried to, unfortunately he didn't survive. But it was nobody important.
No, he died at last. He was a Feygard officer ... a sergeant I think.

umar_guild03_27c.m: I've told you to have patience, my friend. Any thief is dead without patience.

umar_guild03_28a.m: Each of you have your own specific task. Spies must hide their identities, even to their allies.

umar_guild03_28b.m: I mean this is not the time to tell you what you want to know, sorry.

umar_guild03_29.m: Hmm! And now to business. Here's your reward for the good work.

umar_guild03_3.m: Here in the guild, as you know, members range from apprentices to veterans. The veterans are usually specialized in specific jobs.

umar_guild03_30.m:
Take {4000} gold coins, and some bottles of my favorite mead.
Now you deserve a good rest, my friend. You have earned the trust of the Thieves' Guild.
r: Count me in for the next job.

umar_guild03_31a.m: And last but not least, I have some useful information for you. The way from here to the southeast has finally been opened, once Crackshot's hideout was discovered.
r: Good, I'm not going to have to take that detour.
Thank you for the information. Bye.

umar_guild03_31b.m: I will, no doubt about it.

umar_guild03_32.m: However, the Feygard presence is still significant. Be cautious with what you do.
r: I will, thank you for the advice.

umar_guild03_4.m: Troublemaker is my right hand man. He's in charge of planning jobs that have some level of complexity.

umar_guild03_5.m: Pickpocket has developed his stealth skills to such an extreme that he's able to take your equipment, and you'll barely even feel it.

umar_guild03_6a.m: Each person has their own way to reach the top.

umar_guild03_7.m: Anyway, the fact is that one of our veterans has betrayed us.

umar_guild03_8.m: Yes. He and his former comrades were sent to the Fallhaven catacombs.
r: I thought the work there was done since I brought the key of Luthor to you.

umar_guild03_9.m: The key is just the first part. We need to decipher the runes in the key in order to reach the crypt.
r: What crypt? I've never heard of it.

umar_guild04_1.m: Yes, I do have a new task for you. So, listen to me carefully.

umar_guild04_10a.m: Their 20th anniversary beer festival will be celebrated in the next few weeks.
r: I didn't know that I was invited.
But I'm not interested in beer.

umar_guild04_10b.m: No. 80 for them and 20 for us.

umar_guild04_11.m: Don't worry. Even your brother was a helping hand in Sullengard. I'm sure you can do the same as well.
r: He didn't even invite me either.
So you want me to go there?

umar_guild04_12.m: I want you to go to Sullengard and find one of my appointed veterans named Defy.

umar_guild04_13.m: Tell him that it is time to give the bootleg brewers their share to aid in their livelihoods. Especially in paying their taxes.
r: But I need an invitation letter first.
I'll just wait for my brother to do that because it's very far.

umar_guild04_14.m: Hurry now. There's no time to waste.

umar_guild04_15.m: Not again. What's on his mind?
r: I'll ask him again once his head is cool.

umar_guild04_16.m: Sigh. He may be stubborn sometimes but he is a great supervisor. You should ask him once he is calm.
r: I'm going to visit him again. Bye.

umar_guild04_17.m: He can't be gone without our share from the bootleg brewers.
r: I thought he would come back here.

umar_guild04_18.m: Go back to Sullengard and ask the townspeople if they know of his whereabouts.
r: I'm on my way back to Sullengard now. Bye.

umar_guild04_19.m: This is madness! He betrayed us just like Crackshot did.
r: We better find and kill him and his men and retrieve the share to help the people of Sullengard.

umar_guild04_2.m: Here in the guild, as you know, income sources come in different classes from poor to wealthy. The lower-middle class and poor class are usually associated with us.

umar_guild04_20.m: Yes. We must find and kill them and retrieve the share for the sake of Sullengard's living.

umar_guild04_21.m: Fortunately, one of my men found one of his drunk men and had a short talk with him before he bled to death.

umar_guild04_22.m: He said that they will no longer be a part of the Thieves' Guild. They are now referring to themselves as 'Aidem'.
r: What a weird name. For what reason?

umar_guild04_24.m: Such a dishonorable act for they stole {50000} gold coins including the treasures of Sullengard.
r: Their dishonorable act will be their undoing.

umar_guild04_25.m: We still don't know where they are.

umar_guild04_26.m: Sullengard is our friend. Find a way to earn gold.
r: How can we earn that large amount of gold?
This requires so much gold, how can we earn it?

umar_guild04_27.m: I trust that you will find a way. In the meantime, go back to Sullengard and give them the share we promised them so they can go on with their lives.

umar_guild04_28a.m: Immediately report back to me once you are done.
r: I better start looking for gold now.

umar_guild04_28b.m: Here's {1000} gold coins as my financial contribution.

umar_guild04_29.m: Good job, kid! I knew I could count on you. Here, take this blade. It used to be your brother's.
r: Thank you, sir. You can count me in as well to kill Defy.
Thank you sir, but what about Defy and his men?

umar_guild04_3.m: Wealthy class is our highest target. This is why I didn't doubt to give you the first mission to kidnap Ambelie for ransom.
r: That is not my kind of work though.

umar_guild04_30.m: Like I said, we are still looking for him. You should rest for now from your long haul.
r: You're right. My legs are so tired from having to walk back and forth from here to Sullengard so many times.
Yes, I should rest from my long travel.

umar_guild04_4.m: Don't worry, we already made a promise.

umar_guild04_5.m: Anyway, the rest of the class are either with us or against us.

umar_guild04_6.m: Most of the time we made deals and negotiations with them in exchange of peace or protection.

umar_guild04_7.m: One of them is the popular brewery town called 'Sullengard' located far to the south of Vilegard.
r: What makes the place interesting for us?

umar_guild04_8.m: They have a massive bootleg brewery operation because Feygard is unfairly taxing them.

umar_guild04_9.m: As a result, they asked us to help them. We even have 80/20 share of their business.

umar_guild05_1a.m: You are really very hardworking. I can't find new work for you fast enough. You're free for now.

umar_guild05_1b.m: No jobs today my young friend. Maybe some other day.
r: That's a shame. Find more time for my skills then.

umar_guild_1.m: I see .... So you want to get involved in our Guild?
r: Yes, you seem like reasonable people.
No, not really. I'm not interested in being a smug thief.

umar_guild_2a.m: Well, you've shown us you are trustworthy by bringing that key. However, doing just one task does not prove to us that you are eligible to be a member of our guild.
r: But I really want to join your guild!
Really? I didn't see any of your members bringing you "that" key.

umar_guild_2b.m: I'm sorry to hear that. Good luck.

umar_guild_3.m: OK, OK. You will get a chance. But I warn you that from now on, you cannot go back on your choice.

r: Haven't you understood? Just tell me what I have to do.
I need some time to think about it.

umar_guild_5a.m: Very well. Let's see if you're good enough to join our guild. Talk with Troublemaker. He will tell you what you have to do.
r: All right! I'll go see him.

umar_guild_5b.m: I understand your doubts. Come back when you're prepared.

umar_guild_6a.m: Fine. I will keep an eye on you.

umar_guild_6b.m: Not for now. Make sure nobody sees you doing suspicious things. Good luck.

umar_guild_7.m:
OK, listen carefully.
We have heard a noble woman has decided to travel outside Feygard.

umar_lodar_1.m: I really shouldn't tell you. How to get to him is one of our closely guarded secrets in the guild. His hideaway is only reachable by our members.

umar_lodar_2.m: However, I heard that you helped us find the key of Luthor. This is something we have been trying to get for a long time.

umar_lodar_3.m: OK, I'll tell you how to get to Lodar's Hideaway. But you have to promise to keep it a secret. Do not tell anyone. Not even those that appear to be members of the Thieves' Guild.
r: OK, I'll promise to keep it a secret.
I can't give any guarantees, but I will try.

umar_lodar_4.m: Good. The thing is, you not only need to find the place itself, but you also need to utter the correct words to be allowed entry by the guardian.

umar_lodar_5.m: The only one that understands the language of the guardian is the old man Ogam in Vilegard.

umar_lodar_6.m: You should travel to the town of Vilegard and find Ogam. He can help you get the right words to enter Lodar's Hideaway.
r: How do I get to Vilegard?
Thank you. There was something else I wanted to talk about.

umar_novisit_1.m: Hello. How did your search go?

r: Do you have any tasks for me?
I have given them our promised share.
What are we gonna do about Sullengard?
What are your plans for the new traitors?
Matpat told me that Defy and his men left Sullengard.
Defy and his men have left Sullengard.
Defy told me that the time to share will be delayed for no stated reason.
What am I supposed to do in Sullengard again?
Do you have any tasks for me?
Are you going to tell me about the key?
What am I supposed to do again?
What are your plans for the traitors?
Can you continue with what you were telling me about the traitors?
We are supposed to talk about something.
We were supposed to talk about something, right?
We were supposed to talk about something, right?
What am I suppossed to do again?
What am I supposed to do with the noblewoman?
What am I supposed to do with the noblewoman?
I have to talk to you about the noblewoman.
Anything more about my new task?
Anything more about my new task?
Anything more about my new task?
Troublemaker sent me. I have finished the job.

umar_return_2.m: Anything else I can help you with?
r: Can you repeat what you said about Andor?
Yes, I want to know more about the Thieves' Guild.
I've been thinking about joining the guild.

umar_tt.m: Hello $playername, good that you are here. Please talk to Nanath, I am really busy right now.

umar_tt_100.m: $playername, didn't I make it clear that I didn't want to be disturbed?
r: Yes, I'm sorry too. But we need your help.

umar_tt_102.m: [Muttering to himself] Tu quoque, mi fili? Sigh.
r: To break the spell, we need King Luthor's ring. Sly is the only one who knows where it is. But she refuses to cooperate.

umar_tt_110.m: She must. Tell her this password [whispering something]. It means you have direct order from me, Umar. Let no one else hear it.
r: OK. She will listen to you.

umar_tt_120.m: My head is so full. I can hardly concentrate on the important things.
r: I won't bother you any further.
Thoroughness is the key to success.

umar_tt_130.m: Key? To success? Don't talk nonsense.

umar_tt_132.m: There's something else I should think about. But it just doesn't occur to me right now.
r: I better leave you alone now.
I'm sure you'll remember it again.

umar_vilegard_1.m: You travel southeast from Fallhaven. When you reach the main road and the Foaming Flask tavern, head south. It's not very far to the southeast from here.

flagstone.5: Yolgen asked me to have a look at what is wrong with Flagstone prison.
flagstone.10: I met a guard from Stoutford on sentry duty outside a fortress called Flagstone. He told me that Flagstone used to serve as a prison for house Gorland of Stoutford, but it is now abandoned. Recently, undead have started pouring out of Flagstone. I should investigate the source of the undead monsters. The guard tells me to return to him if I need help.
flagstone.20: I found a dug out tunnel beneath Flagstone, that seems to lead to a larger cave. The cave is guarded by a demon that I am not even able to approach. Maybe the guard outside Flagstone knows more?
flagstone.30: The guard suggested that the former warden may have something to do with this, and I should go and look for him. If I find him I should return to the guard with any important news.
flagstone.31: I found the former warden of Flagstone on the upper level. Among his remains I found a necklace with some inscriptions. I should return to the guard now.
flagstone.40: I have learned the words required to approach the demon beneath Flagstone. 'Daylight Shadow'. It seems like the warden has something to do with the monster invasion.
flagstone.50: Deep beneath Flagstone, I found a powerful winged demon. It seems like the warden kept on running the prison and experimented with necromancy.
flagstone.60: I found one prisoner, Narael, alive deep beneath Flagstone. Narael was once a citizen of Nor City. He is too weak to walk by himself, but if I can find his wife in Nor City, I would be handsomely rewarded.
flagstone.70: I approached the sentry again and he was happy to hear the source of the undead is gone. I should talk to Yolgen, the priest of Stoutford, for a reward.
flagstone.100: Yolgen rewarded me handsomely for my efforts and is happy that there is one thing less the citizens of Stoutford have to worry about.

Thieves02.2: After completing my first task I'm considered a member of Thieves' Guild. Now I have to perform a very risky task. Umar sent me to kidnap a noble woman from Feygard, without being discovered.
Thieves02.4: She was recently seen in the Foaming Flask tavern.
Thieves02.6: Umar gave me some advice. My strength is not always the solution. I must "use my tongue" to avoid raising suspicion in the tavern.
Thieves02.10: Ambelie Laumwill doesn't want to come with me peacefully. I cannot make a scene, or the guards will alert other patrols. Maybe talking with them would solve the situation.
Thieves02.15: I have "used my tongue" with the main Feygard soldier in the Foaming Flask tavern. He gave me permission to "escort back" Ambelie.
Thieves02.20: I knocked out Ambelie. I will take her back to the Guild.
Thieves02.21: I have decided not to kidnap Ambelie. I must think of another solution.
Thieves02.24: Ambelie gave me a very valuable necklace. I must talk with Umar and persuade him to no longer pursue her.
Thieves02.30: I safely brought Ambelie to the basement. However, keeping her here could be dangerous.
Thieves02.35: Umar believes there is a secure room for these types of "visitors". I should talk to Troublemaker.
Thieves02.40: I have talked to Troublemaker about the place Umar believes it's okay to safely keep the hostage.
Thieves02.45: Troublemaker has given me the key to the Guild brig. I should take Ambelie there and leave her to wake up.
Thieves02.50: I've inserted the key and moved the lever. A hatchway has opened in the room.
Thieves02.55: I left Ambelie in that ugly, dark, and cold place. I should go back.
Thieves02.60: Troublemaker gave me some bread for Ambelie. The guild doesn't want her to starve to death. Indeed, they want her to be as comfortable as possible. I must go to the brig again.
Thieves02.65: I gave the bread to Ambelie. I should report Troublemaker that I completed the job.
Thieves02.70: The job finally seems to be finished. I just have to talk with Umar again. However, I do not feel good about this. Kidnappings are definitely not my kind of job.
Thieves02.75: I completed this task successfully. Umar told me they have sent couriers to Feygard, and the ransom is almost guaranteed. He paid me for my work.
Thieves02.76: Umar took the necklace as compensation for my errors. Everything is fine again.

Thieves03.1: Time to rest and prepare myself to start the next job. I should go to the tavern.
Thieves03.2: I really need to take a break ....
Thieves03.3: I am now fully rested, so I should go back to Umar.
Thieves03.4: Umar told me about a group of traitors led by a veteran of the Guild. It seems he stole the Key of Luthor.
Thieves03.5: Umar went on to say that this team leader  was known as "Crackshot". He is probably also the responsible for a murder on the Duleian road.
Thieves03.10: Crackshot and his henchmen are probably hiding somewhere near the Duleian road. I must ask people there whether they have seen them.
Thieves03.11: It seems that Benbyr, a suspicious man outside Crossroads Guardhouse, doesn't know what I'm talking about.
Thieves03.15: A Crossroads guard told me that Feygard has sent more soldiers to the south, to try and find the criminals' hideout.
Thieves03.20: The barricade guard has a big mouth, and told me all I needed to know. The hideout is near a place full of larval burrowers. I need to move faster than the patrols to reach the hideout before them.
Thieves03.21: I found a small hole which seems to lead to a cave. Crackshot and his henchmen are probably hiding there.
Thieves03.22: I reached the hideout and saw some recent blood stains. Maybe there was a fight there.
Thieves03.24: I heard screams and sword clashes nearby. I should take a look.
Thieves03.25: There was a massacre. The Feygard patrol reached this place, but they seem to have all been killed. I must continue.
Thieves03.26: As I progressed down the corridor the air became thicker. The blood smell was stronger, and I found another dying soldier. He said something about his sergeant and some other guy.
Thieves03.27: As I progressed down the corridor the air became thicker. The blood smell was stronger, and I found a dying soldier. He said something about his sergeant and some other guy.
Thieves03.28: I found another dying soldier. There was a massacre. The Feygard patrol reached this place, but they seem to have all been killed. I must continue.
Thieves03.30: I've found the patrol sergeant. He advised me to leave this dangerous place.
Thieves03.31: The patrol sergeant told me about what happened before. He's tired and wounded, so I willl avenge his fellows.
Thieves03.32: The patrol sergeant has left to call for backup. Now I'm alone again. Time to defeat Crackshot.
Thieves03.35: I killed Crackshot and he had the key of Luthor with him. I have to go back and report to Umar.
Thieves03.36: I tried to open the door behind Crackshot, but for some reason I cannot get the key into the lock.
Thieves03.40: The dying Crackshot said something about the key. If he told the truth, it could be cursed.
Thieves03.41: I tried to open the door behind Crackshot, but for some reason I could not get the key turned in the lock.
Thieves03.45: I reported about the situation to Umar, and gave him the key. He did not seem to want to tell me more about the key - yet.
Thieves03.50: Finally, this job is done. Now I should take a rest and regain my strength.

stoutford_castle.5: I tried to free this castle from the undead Lord Erwyn. But whenever I kill him, he reappears. I should seek help...
stoutford_castle.10: I talked to Yolgen, the Shadow priest of Stoutford, and he told me that the mighty Lord Erwyn used to reside here, but Lord Erwyn and his army were crushed during a war, the castle was sacked and the house extinguished. But recently Erwyn's knights have risen from the dead. Yolgen asked me to rid Stoutford of these undead once and for all.
stoutford_castle.12: I should ask Tahalendor for some special artifact that I can use to defeat powerful undead.
stoutford_castle.14: Tahalendor gave me a pair of special coins that I can use to defeat powerful undead.
stoutford_castle.16: I slew Lord Erwyn himself and ensured that he remains dead now.
stoutford_castle.20: I slew all the undead knights.
stoutford_castle.42: Among his remains I found a strange ring. I should show it to Yolgen.
stoutford_castle.50: Yolgen examined the ring thoroughly. He suspects it has somehow come from Mt. Galmore and reanimated the long dead soldiers. I should be wary of the evil grasp of Mt. Galmore and whatever lurks there...
stoutford_castle.60: I kept the ring for myself, which upset Yolgen. I should keep looking for its previous owner.
stoutford_castle.70: I kept the ring for myself and didn't tell Yolgen about it. He was suspicious but couldn't do anything about it. I should keep looking for its previous owner.

andor.1: My father Mikhail says that Andor has not been home since yesterday. I should go look for him in the village.
andor.10: Leonid tells me that he saw Andor talking to Gruil. I should go ask Gruil if he knows more.
andor.20: Gruil wants me to bring him a poison gland. Then he might talk more. He tells me that some poisonous snakes have such a gland.
andor.30: Gruil tells me that Andor was looking for someone called Umar. I should go ask his friend Gaela in Fallhaven to the east.
andor.40: I talked to Gaela in Fallhaven. He tells me to go see Bucus and ask about the Thieves' Guild.
andor.50: Bucus has allowed me to enter the hatch in the derelict house in Fallhaven. I should go talk to Umar.
andor.51: Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild recognized me, but must have me confused with Andor. Apparently, Andor has been to see him.
andor.55: Umar told me that Andor went to see a potion maker called Lodar. I should search for his hideaway.
andor.61: I heard a story in Loneford, where it seemed like Andor had been in Loneford, and that he might have had something to do with the illness that the people are suffering from there. I am not sure if it actually was Andor. If it was Andor, why would he have made the people of Loneford ill?
andor.62: Andor might have gone to do some business with a rich man in Brimhaven after he left Loneford.
andor.65: It looks like Andor was involved in the destruction of the Brimhaven dam.
andor.70: I have found the potion-maker Lodar, and heard his story about Andor. Andor went to visit Lodar in his hideaway to get a sample of something called Narwood extract. Lodar happened to notice that there was someone travelling together with Andor, that hid among the trees and did not seem to want Lodar to spot him.
andor.71: Shortly after Andor and the person he was travelling with had left, strange things started to happen in the woods around Lodar's hideaway, and Lodar himself seemed to be affected by it somehow. Lodar believes that something disturbed the tomb below his cabin, and awoke the Hira'zinn.
andor.72: Since I helped Lodar defeat the Hira'zinn, he promised to help me in return. He gave me a piece of paper that should allow me to enter the Valanyr temple of the Shadow in Nor City. He told me to seek out lady Lydalon in the temple for further assistance.
andor.80: All clues so far as to where Andor went point to Nor City. I should travel to Nor City by following the Duleian road to the southeast and look for more clues there.
andor.85: Andor may have been in Stoutford.
andor.86: Andor had something to do with the demon under the church in Stoutford.
andor.90: At Castle Guynmart I learned from Steward Unkorh that some time ago Andor was also there as a guest.
andor.92: Unkorh gave me the bonemeal potion box that Andor had given him for safekeeping.
andor.100: While exploring the town of Sullengard, I so happened to stumble upon my mother and my aunt to whom I have never met. Mother has insisted that I go home so we can talk.
andor.110: After talking with mother back at home, she and I tried to brainstorm about where Andor could be. She reminded me about Andor's friend Stanwick who lives in Brightport. We agreed that going to talk to him might be the next logical thing to do.
andor.120: In the dungeons of Laeroth manor, Kotheses, the torturer, mentioned that he had taught Andor the basics of torturing.
andor.125: Vaelric confirmed that Andor visited him recently. Andor sought to learn Vaelric's skills and left quickly, clutching what he came for. His actions raise more questions about his intentions.
andor.126: In Brightport, I was finally able to meet Stanwick, but due to his hazy memory, he was not able to help me learn anything about the whereabouts of Andor.
andor.127: Regaining his peace of mind after I helped him, Stanwick said he'll tell me more about Andor, once he gathers his thoughts.
andor.128: Stanwick gave me a signet ring that I should show to his father. Jorwick, in Nor City.
andor.130: Andor was trying to find out from Seraphina about terrible monsters in the hideout near the place with the larval burrowers.
andor.131: Elysa in the Brightport's thieves guild told me that Andor has bought a map to the sewers of Feygard.
andor.132: While investigating the Brightport theft I learned from Bryma that Andor was the one who stole the important document, and brought it to her in exchange for her alchemy knowledge.
andor.140: I saw Andor in the mountains of Galmore. We were able to exchange a few words before he disappeared again.
andor.145: I met Andor on the road to Feygard, where he was buying food from Rosmara. He disappeared again.
andor.147: I met Andor on the road to Nor City, where he was buying supplies from Alynndir. He disappeared again.
andor.910: I decided to settle down on the top of Mt. Galmore. For this I needed to find a rich and discreet man to rebuild the ruins according to my wishes. Andor will now have to go and find himself.
andor.912: The construction contract for my new home was completed. I was curious to see what it would look like.
andor.914: I visited my new residence on the top of Mt. Galmore. There I would help the people of Dhayavar as a hero and protect them from villains. Or would I become a villain myself? We'll see.
andor.999: [Quest is not completable at this time.]

wanted_men.10: Off the main road, southeast of Deebo's Orchard, I've stumbled across a group of sketchy looking men with familiar voices.
wanted_men.15: The sketchy looking men with familiar voices turned out to be the Aidem thieves from Sullengard. They were hiding-out in the woods.
wanted_men.20: While speaking with Defy, I've learned the he and his men have a grudge against the Thieves' Guild and they want to "hit them where it really hurts". Whatever that means.
wanted_men.25: Defy has revealed the location of the Thieves' Guild's vault of treasure - an underground storage unit accessible from the vacant house south of Fallhaven.
wanted_men.30: Defy has asked me to convince Troublemaker to let me borrow the key long enough that I can bring it back to Defy.
wanted_men.35: Defy has agreed to pay me 20 percent of the looted Thieves' Guild treasure if I get the key from Troublemaker and hand it over to him.
wanted_men.40: Defy has instructed me to bring Troublemaker's key to him at their new hideout located west of the Sutdover River, where the rail tracks end.
wanted_men.45: I have talked my way into acquiring the Thieves' Guild's vault key from Troublemaker, but I must return it to him quickly after I am done with it.
wanted_men.50: I told Troublemaker all that I knew about Defy, his men, and the "Lost Traveler", Alaric and how they hired me to help rob the Thieves' Guild.
wanted_men.55: Troublemaker has asked me to help him trap Defy by providing Defy with a fake key. When Defy arrives at the secret vault, the Guild members will be waiting for him.
wanted_men.56:
I gave Defy the fake version of the vault key that Troublemaker gave me. In return, Defy has given me a fake version of Troublemaker's vault key and has instructed me to return it to Troublemaker.
Defy then told me to report back to the vault in order to collect my share of the gold. He has no idea that the key I gave him is a fake.
wanted_men.57: I have reported back to the vacant house and I met Rennik there. He informed me that the Thieves' Guild has apprehended all five men and that they are now in the Guild jail.
wanted_men.60: Defy has given me a fake version of Troublemaker's vault key and has instructed me to return it to Troublemaker. Then I should report back to the vault in order to collect my share of the gold.
wanted_men.65: I have given the fake Aidem key to Troublemaker as a replacement for the real vault key.
wanted_men.70: I reported back to Defy and he rewarded me with 25000 gold.
wanted_men.75: I told Defy that I was keeping the key for myself and plan to loot the Thieves' Guild's vault myself. A fight ensued.
wanted_men.76: I have killed Defy, his three henchmen and Alaric. I really should go back to Fallhaven and talk to Troublemaker again.
wanted_men.77: I've unlocked the hatch leading to the vault. It's time to head down.
wanted_men.80: I informed Troublemaker that Defy and his men are now dead.

Thieves04.10: Umar told me to visit Defy in Sullengard to instruct him to give the villagers their share.
Thieves04.20: Defy told me that there will be a delay in giving the villagers of Sullengard their fair share for some unknown reason. I must report this to Umar at once.
Thieves04.30: Umar instructed me to talk to Defy once more.
Thieves04.35: Defy and his friends have vanished! Back to Umar ...
Thieves04.40: I told Umar about the disappearance of Defy and his men. But Umar didn't believe me and he even sent me back to find them. I better ask the villagers there.
Thieves04.50: There was a distressed man, whom just had his first child, who hinted to me of wherabouts of Defy and his men. I must report this to Umar once more.
Thieves04.60: With Sullengard running into financial trouble, Umar is enraged by Defy's traitorous way.
Thieves04.70: Umar gave me a task to give the mayor at least 50000 gold coins as the promised share for their living. After that, I'm instructed to report back to him.
Thieves04.75: Sullengard has been given their share of the gold and now it's time to revisit Umar.
Thieves04.80: At last, Sullengard can now sleep calmly and eat sufficiently with their finances restored.

sullengard_hidden.3: I need to leave the Sullengard tavern.

sullengard_hidden.18: Player has helped Grazia cross the bridge.

sullengard_hidden.24: The PC has asked Lamberta if she had seen or knew anything about the armory theft.
sullengard_hidden.25: The PC has asked Mayor Ale if he had seen or knew anything about the armory theft.
sullengard_hidden.26: The PC listened to the entire argument between Valentina and Mikhail.
sullengard_hidden.27: The PC has admired the magnificent trees of the Sullengard forest.

thieves_hidden.30: Spoke to dying Crackshot. Remove block road1
thieves_hidden.70: thieves3 - Open door (can currently not be fulfilled, beause the blessed key of luthor can't be obtained in the game)

Thieves01.5:
After giving him the key of Luthor and talking with Umar about Andor, I needed to ask him about Thieves' Guild itself.
I want to join them to see what kind of jobs they do.
Thieves01.10: Umar told me to talk with Troublemaker regarding my first task for the Guild.
Thieves01.15: Troublemaker told me to bring him three journals from spies of the guild. First I have to talk with Leta in my village, then with Dunla in Vilegard's tavern, and finally with Fanamor somewhere around Crossroads guardhouse.
Thieves01.20: I have to remember to tell them the password "You are no one. No one knows you. No one has seen you."
Thieves01.25: Leta gave me her journal and advised me to not raise suspicion.
Thieves01.30: I got Dunla's journal without any problem. I have set out to get the last journal.
Thieves01.40: Fanamor has been gravely wounded, and the Feygard Scout grabbed the journal.
Thieves01.45: After I had killed the Feygard scout I talked again with Fanamor. She's losing blood quickly, so I have to bring her a bandage. I need to find a trustworthy priest.
Thieves01.50: Thoronir gave me a bandage. I have to return to Fanamor as soon as possible.
Thieves01.51: Unfortunately, I was not able to save Fanamor's life. However, I did get her journal.
Thieves01.55: Fanamor is alive and will find her own way to return.
Thieves01.60: I returned to Troublemaker and gave him the journals. He told me to talk with Umar, maybe he has another task for me.

lodar.10: I should find a potion maker called Lodar. Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me that I will need to know the right words to pass a guardian in order to reach Lodar's hideaway.
lodar.15: Umar told me I should go see someone called Ogam in Vilegard. Ogam can supply me with the right words to reach Lodar's hideaway.
lodar.20: I have visited Ogam in southwest Vilegard. He was talking in what seemed like riddles. I could barely make out some details when I asked about Lodar's hideaway. 'Halfway between the Shadow and the light. Rocky formations.' and the words 'Glow of the Shadow.' were among the things he said. I am not sure what they mean.
lodar.30: I have found a formation of rocks on the Duleian Road. It does not look like they were naturally placed, but rather that they are meant to symbolize something.
lodar.31: Could this be the 'rocky formation' that the old man Ogam mentioned? If that is the case, then this might be a clue as to where Andor went.
lodar.40: In the woods close to the rocky formation, I encountered a creature blocking the way into the forest.
lodar.45: By speaking the words that Ogam had mentioned, the creature moved out of the way, and almost seemed to welcome me further into the forest.
lodar.50: I encountered a guard from Feygard in the woods. He told me a tale of a madman that the guards from Feygard are searching for. The madman is wanted for a number of reasons that he would not disclose. He warned me both about the twisty mazes ahead, and about the madman. Apparently, several guards have gone missing after venturing forth, either by getting lost in the maze, or by something that the madman has done to them.
lodar.51: Before leaving, the guard warned me both about the twisty mazes ahead, and about the madman. Apparently, several guards have gone missing after venturing forth, either by getting lost in the maze, or by something that the madman has done to them.
lodar.60: I found another rocky formation that looked out of place.
lodar.71: I encountered another guard from Feygard, disoriented and lost. The things he said did not make sense.
lodar.72: I encountered another guard from Feygard, that seemed to be affected by something. He attacked me without provocation.
lodar.73: I encountered another guard from Feygard, that rambled of something that 'lurks underneath'. He attacked me without provocation.
lodar.80: I found yet another rocky formation that looked out of place.
lodar.90: In a well-hidden cave, I encountered yet another rocky formation that looked similar to the other ones that I've already seen. I must be getting close to whatever these formations lead to.
lodar.100: In the cave, I reached what looks like a tomb. I was unable to venture further into the tomb because of something that held me back.
lodar.110: After navigating through the immense twisty green maze and the damp cave, I have reached a cabin in a clearing. The cabin is occupied by the potion-maker called Lodar.

misc_nondisplay.20: Told by Umar to say he sent you at the inn.

bucus.10: Bucus in Fallhaven might know something about Andor. He wants me to bring him the key of Luthor from the catacombs beneath Fallhaven church.
bucus.20: The catacombs beneath Fallhaven church are closed off. Athamyr is the only one with both permission and the bravery to enter them. I should go see him in his house southwest of the church.
bucus.30: Athamyr wants me to bring him some cooked meat, then maybe he will want to talk more.
bucus.40: I brought some cooked meat to Athamyr.
bucus.50: Athamyr has given me permission to enter the catacombs beneath Fallhaven church.
bucus.100: I brought Bucus the key of Luthor.

troubling_times.10: I went to the Thieves' Guild in Fallhaven looking for things to do.
troubling_times.20: Since I had helped Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.30: Since I had looted the Thieves' Guild vault after killing Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.40: I met Nanath, who's scared and upset, because someone put a spell on all members of the Thieves' Guild. This spell made all thieves noticeable. He asked me if I could help dispel the spell.
troubling_times.50: Nanath told me to find the Shadow priest who had cast the spell on the Guild.
troubling_times.60: I set out interviewing Shadow priests to find who had cast the spell.
troubling_times.70: Talion, Shadow priest of Loneford, had cast the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell on the Guild, on payment from Dameni, a mysterious lady leading a band of toughs
troubling_times.80: Talion could dispel the spell, using a few items - Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, Luthor's ring.  He also wanted 50000 gold.
troubling_times.82: I have informed Nanath about the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell and Talion's demands.
troubling_times.90: Nanath told me Thieves' Guild would give me the 50000 gold back when I have got the spell dispelled.
troubling_times.95: Nanath asked if I had already found Luthor's ring.
troubling_times.100: I went back to Nanath as I couldn't find Luthor's ring anywhere.
troubling_times.105: He told me to seek out Fanamor's friend Sly Seraphina near the Sutdover bridge.
troubling_times.110: Seraphina didn't believe me. She told me to go away.
troubling_times.115: Nanath sent me to Umar. He should make sure Sly carries out the order.
troubling_times.120: Umar told me one of his secret passwords to convince Seraphina.
troubling_times.130: Sly Seraphina said that Luthor's ring was to be found in the cave which Crackshot tried to open. The door was sealed by Umar and Seraphina to prevent monsters in that cave from devastating Dhayavar. The sealing was done by using Luthor's items. She and Umar decided to separate them, and keep them separate.
troubling_times.140: Seraphina felt that the danger was too high to open that door. So she disappeared.
troubling_times.150: I had to find Sly Seraphina again.
troubling_times.160: Nanath told me to look for her in her usual hiding places: Near one of the towns Sullengard, Stoutford, Vilegard, Prim, Loneford, or Brimhaven.
troubling_times.170: Talion said that without the items he asked for he couldn't help. I had to find Seraphina.
troubling_times.180: After beating the tough guys protecting Seraphina, she was convinced that I was strong enough to help her beat the monsters in the cave.
troubling_times.190: Seraphina gave me back the money she had stolen from me earlier.
troubling_times.192: I have to ask Umar for Luthor's key.
troubling_times.195: Seraphina agreed to help me and told me to meet her at the locked door in the cave where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.200: I met Seraphina at the cave door where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.210: Seraphina could open the door with Luthor's key wearing also his gloves. She entered the cave behind the door.
troubling_times.230: Seraphina got injured attacking one of the monsters.
troubling_times.240: I have killed the monsters blocking the entrance.
troubling_times.252: I tried to poison Seraphina, but she noticed in time. At least she didn't notice that I did it on purpose.
troubling_times.255: Seraphina already started the search for the ring.
troubling_times.260: I searched the cave for Luthor's ring. I couldn't find it.
troubling_times.270: Sly Seraphina had found the ring. She gave it to me and told me to keep it safe. She disappeared again, probably back to Sutdover bridge. I had to go to Talion.
troubling_times.280: I gave 50000 gold, Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, and Luthor's ring to Talion.
troubling_times.290: Talion used them to undo the spell.
troubling_times.300: Talion returned Luthor's ring. The other rings were broken in the process though and the Tears of the Shadow potion was used up of course.
troubling_times.302: The room with the dangerous creatures has been locked and sealed again.
troubling_times.310: Nanath gave me 75000 gold as a reward for a job well done.
troubling_times.320: Sly Seraphina was friendly to me - for now.

charwood2.10: I've heard a story that the whole reason for the Charwood hills being invaded by the monsters in the first place was that something had been awoken deep in the Charwood mine. The people in the Charwood cabin say that the miners uncovered some sort of marking on the ground in a cave, with strange noises coming from below it. When they finally broke through the ground around the markings, all the troubles started. I should talk to Maevalia again.
